title: Summit: a landing page for a Shopify planning tool
summaryLead: A landing page for a Shopify planning product, built to explain it fast.
story: Summit is a product for Shopify agencies and consultants. It takes scattered discovery notes and turns them into requirements, risk assessments, roadmaps and QA plans. The people who'd use it live in spreadsheets and inboxes, so the site had to show what comes out, not just describe it. We kept it light and framework-free, and let the workflow section and the score ring do the explaining.

features.title: Grain and fluid type
features.text: A paper-like grain, and headlines that resize smoothly from phone to desktop.
features.story: The grain is an SVG noise filter embedded in the page, so it doesn't cost an image request. Headline sizes come from one CSS function, clamp(), instead of a pile of breakpoints.

features.title: Workflow
features.text: How discovery notes become requirements, a risk assessment, a roadmap and a QA plan.

features.title: CSS score ring
features.text: A score ring drawn in CSS, with no chart library.
features.story: We didn't want Chart.js or D3 for one ring. It's a CSS conic-gradient with a smaller circle on top, so it draws instantly.
